title: Plan & usage
quotaResetNote: Daily send quota resets at 00:00 Beijing time (UTC+8).
teamUpgradeHint: Upgrade to Team for multi-user collaboration.
cancelScheduledNote: Your plan stays active until the end of the current period, then moves to Free without losing contacts or members.

nudges.contactsRemaining: {count, plural, one {# active contact slot} other {# active contact slots}} left. Existing contacts are kept once full.
nudges.seatsRemaining: {count, plural, one {# team seat} other {# team seats}} left. Add-on seats are not available yet.
nudges.memberCapLocked: Active members exceed your plan seat limit. Members remain listed, but editor actions are paused until an admin removes extra members or upgrades.

adminOnlyUpgrade: Only workspace admins can upgrade the plan.
teamSkuUnavailable: Online checkout for Team is not enabled yet. Contact support or an admin to upgrade.
manageSubscriptionHint: To update renewal, change payment method, or request a refund, use the "Manage subscription" link in your payment receipt email.
cancelRenewalConfirm: Cancel auto-renewal? You can keep using your plan through the end of the current period, then revert to Free without losing data.
proToTeamHint: If you already subscribe to Pro, cancel the Pro renewal via your payment receipt after upgrading to Team to avoid duplicate charges.

checkout.descriptionTeam: Team ({cycle}): Up to 25,000 active contacts, 20 seats, full activity logs, and team invitations—plus Pro sending limits and open/click analytics.
checkout.descriptionPro: Pro ({cycle}): Up to 5,000 active contacts, unlimited custom templates and campaign confirmations, open/click analytics, and 7-day activity logs for one user.
checkout.thirdPartyPaymentNote: Payments are processed securely by a third-party provider; card details are never stored here.
checkout.intervalChangedNotice: Billing cycle changed. Please verify the discount code again.
checkout.verifyBeforeCheckout: Please click Verify to confirm your discount code first.
checkout.altHint: Card / Apple Pay / Google Pay / Local cards
checkout.proCancelReminder: After Team activates, cancel your existing Pro auto-renewal from your Pro receipt email to avoid double billing.
checkout.renewalFootnote: Subscriptions renew automatically each cycle. Canceling returns the workspace to Free at period end. Use "Manage subscription" in your receipt email to manage billing or refunds.
